topic: JetBrains Central Agentic Platform: Early Access Guide

key_points: Official JetBrains announcement of Central on March 24, 2026
Described as 'an open system for agentic software development'
Three core pillars: governance/control, agent execution infrastructure, agent optimization/context
Early Access Program launches Q2 2026 with limited design partners
Launch partners include Google Cloud, Anthropic, and OpenAI
Simultaneous announcement of Code With Me retirement
JetBrains Central positions as the control and execution plane for agent-driven software production
Code With Me officially retiring — 2026.1 is last supported version
Code With Me plugin available until Q1 2027, relay infrastructure shut down Q1 2027
Signals that JetBrains is shifting from pair programming to agentic workflows as the future of collaboration
Air Team (built on Central) is JetBrains' answer to the team coordination gap
JetBrains Air launched as public preview alongside Central announcement
Air is the agentic development environment built on the abandoned Fleet IDE codebase
Developers can delegate coding tasks to multiple AI agents concurrently
Air requires a JetBrains AI subscription or agent provider API keys (except Anthropic)
Air Team (coming soon) adds collaborative multi-agent workflow orchestration for teams
Comprehensive guide to JetBrains Central architecture and use cases
Governance layer: policy enforcement, identity and access management, observability, audit logging, per-agent cost attribution
Agent execution: cloud runtimes with sandboxing, resource allocation, failure recovery
Shared semantic context layer enables agents to access accumulated project knowledge rather than starting cold
Supports Junie, Claude, Codex, Gemini CLI, and custom-built agents
JetBrains Central positioned as enterprise governance infrastructure for AI coding agents
Turns autonomous agent workflows from experimental prototypes into enterprise-ready systems
No-lock-in architecture: organizations keep existing tooling and add new agents/models freely
JetBrains Console (already live) handles org management, license distribution, AI quota management
Pricing structure: per-seat subscription for governance layer + pay-as-you-go for agent execution
